issue_description.description: Read the assigned changed files and traced their callers, content schema, publication filtering, route configuration, sitemap and robots generation, layouts, and generated route shaping. The current article headline flows separately from the SEO title, noindex documents suppress JSON-LD, and the linked WebPage and BlogPosting graph preserves the approved Jay identity and source dates. Existing image dimensions match their source assets. Curated llms links use current canonical routes and filtered published articles. IndexNow is an explicit manual command with production-branch and after-cutover gates, local sitemap-derived candidates, same-origin checks, ownership and live-byte verification, crawler-policy checks, bounded retries and safe failures. Retained noindex pages are supported as removal candidates rather than new indexable submissions. No recommendation is required because no reachable defect was established. Coverage is limited to this partition and the current authored data; no hosted publication, external service acceptance, browser run, build, deployment or full test suite was performed by this worker.
